capabilities: Stream and play music from a Subsonic-compatible server in a sidebar player
Browse albums, artists, playlists, and internet radio with drill-in navigation and search
Build and manage a persistent queue, playlists, and stations seeded from songs or artists
Display synced lyrics with click-to-seek and fetch missing lyrics from LRCLIB
Sync favorites and scrobble play counts back to the server
extras: Desktop-only. Credentials are stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins/stereo/data.json inside the vault; the README warns to use a dedicated, limited server account if the vault is synced or shared. States no telemetry or analytics.
problem: Obsidian has no way to play music from a personal streaming server, so listening while working in notes requires switching to another app.

relations.evidence: Stream music from your Navidrome or Subsonic-compatible server inside Obsidian.

requires.name: Music server account; admin account only for managing internet radio stations

summary: Music player plugin that streams music from a Navidrome or Subsonic-compatible server in a sidebar, with library browsing, queue, stations, and lyrics.
